nonblocking_observations: Freeze coverage gap, most important: the frozen code path imports panel.py, content_lexicon.py, and evidence.py, none of which SHARED_FROZEN_INPUTS binds. An edit to content_lexicon.fold between review and execute would silently change every screening boolean while verify-evidence still reported OK. It does not affect the network action authorized here because the four request URLs are fully determined by the hash-bound config and the byte-compared intents, and the screening flags are recomputable from the retained raw fields and the CAS body. The gap is pre-existing and identical in aic_metadata_freeze_r2 and broad_wikidata_freeze_r2. Fix in a later census ID.

Zero-row fail-open: info.total 0 with an empty data list is accepted and published as a complete census. Nothing cross-checks that a painter known to be held by Cleveland returned more than zero rows. Every non-empty divergence is fail-closed, so the exposure is a wasted one-shot census ID rather than corrupted evidence.

Unverifiable without a network call: httpx encodes the space in the artist query as '+'. Standard query parsers decode '+' as a space, but a backend that treats it literally would produce the zero-row case above.

Contract wording inconsistency: pagination_rule says a provider-side cap 'requires a new census ID with a larger frozen limit'. A larger limit cannot fix a server-side cap; that case needs pagination. The code is correct and both cases are terminal; only the remedy sentence is wrong.

Retention narrower than the module docstring claims: parse_response builds cma_record from a fixed 20-name RETAINED_FIELDS tuple, so any other Cleveland field survives only as a name in field_presence plus the gitignored raw CAS body. Protocol 2.1 section 7.4 evaluates description, genre, and subject fields at R2; if the workspace is lost, R2 would need a new census.

The oil/canvas screen is a bag-of-tokens subset test, so 'oil on canvas mounted on panel' passes. Section 7.1 requires no incompatible primary support; that discrimination is deferred to authority reconciliation. The candidate gate is looser than section 7.1.
as_int rejects floats, so a rendition reporting dimensions as 2000.0 yields no geometry and fails the media screen silently. Brittleness only; Cleveland returns integers or numeric strings today.

The painting screen matches the exact token 'painting'. A plural or renamed provider type value would silently zero out all candidates rather than terminate. This follows the stated non-terminal-field design but is a second path to a zero-candidate complete census.
The User-Agent identifies the project and purpose but carries no contact URL. Several museum APIs ask for one; the fixed-seed census included one and this route should too.
Commit 48820c6's message says the freeze binds 15 inputs; it binds 14. Cosmetic.
review_summary: Recomputed every hash in the freeze and the aggregate; confirmed all bound bytes are recoverable at the recorded commit 6c497bf, with the prepare-created intents file recoverable in the working tree; verify-evidence clean at 2837/2837. Independently rebuilt the four request intents from the config under four PYTHONHASHSEED values and obtained byte-identical output every time, with Cezanne percent-encoded as UTF-8 and limit/skip matching the frozen screening contract. Scope is genuinely metadata-only: the endpoint is pinned three ways, redirects are forbidden and re-checked, and no code in the path can fetch an image, admit a work, extract a feature, or generate. All six pre-execution outputs are absent. The pagination rule is fail-closed in every divergent case constructed, including both server-side-cap variants. Across 42 malformed and unexpected payloads the parser raised nothing uncaught and only id, a non-object row, and the pagination fields are terminal, so it does not repeat the fatal-frozen-parser failure mode of the three earlier routes. Publication is atomic, the lock is O_EXCL, and a second execute is refused. Four unauthenticated GETs spaced 2 s apart behind a self-identifying User-Agent is courteous treatment of a public Open Access API. Nothing found that should stop this run.
